summary: Yet I see the web has so fundamental to literacy, that the idea of friction free tech feels more imprisoning. As if we said since the average reading level is X we won't read any books that are harder than X level.. Controlling your data and owning learning.

body_html:
Yet I see the web has so fundamental to literacy, that the idea of friction free tech feels more imprisoning. As if we said since the average reading level is X we won't read any books that are harder than X level..
Controlling your data and owning learning.
